about: Android string resources: resource name -> the English text, exactly as iOS writes it. build_android_strings.py takes the Spanish and Portuguese from es.json and pt.json, so both apps say the same words.

strings.font_caption_literata: Made for long reading on screens
strings.font_caption_crimson_pro: A graceful Garamond-style face for long chapters
strings.font_caption_source_serif: A calm, sturdy serif with an even rhythm
strings.font_caption_spectral: A light, refined face made for screens
strings.no_cross_references: No cross references for this verse.
strings.no_verses_found: No verses found in the %@. Try fewer words or a different spelling.
strings.no_highlights_message: In the reader, tap a verse and pick a color.
strings.no_notes_message: Write about a verse from the reader, or start a journal entry with the button below.
strings.no_bookmarks_message: Tap the bookmark in the reader to mark your place.
strings.language_footer: Versely is available in English, Spanish and Portuguese.
strings.welcome_read_message: A calm reader that works offline. Highlight, take notes and pick up where you left off.
strings.welcome_listen_message: Hear chapters read aloud and follow along, verse by verse.
strings.welcome_pray_message: Keep a prayer journal, hold on to the verses that speak to you and look back on answered prayers.
strings.onboarding_tagline: Scripture, quietly and beautifully. Everything works offline.
strings.switch_any_time: You can switch any time from the reader.
strings.start_with_john: Or start with the Gospel of John
strings.summary_kjv: The classic English Bible, cherished for its majestic, poetic language.
strings.summary_web: A modern, readable translation in everyday English.
strings.summary_asv: A precise, literal translation valued for careful study.
strings.summary_blivre: The 1819 Almeida translation, updated into Brazilian Portuguese and free to read and share.
strings.sign_in_message: Sign in to back up your highlights, notes, reading plans and prayers, and see them on all your devices. Everything also works without an account.
strings.cloud_not_set_up: Cloud sync isn't set up in this build.
strings.guest_footer: As a guest, everything stays on this device. You can sign in any time and your notes will come with you.
strings.google_failed: Sign in with Google didn't work. Please try again.
strings.apple_failed: Sign in with Apple didn't work. Please try again.
strings.confirm_email: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
strings.reset_sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
strings.session_ended: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
strings.unexpected_response: The server sent an unexpected response.
strings.server_unreachable: Couldn't reach Versely's server. Check your connection and try again.
